Name: AMPlify Valley
Author: jrorr0606
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
AMPlify Valley adds Mia and her pet clinic to Pelican Town. After receiving Mia's introductory letter, players can help care for rescued animals by completing a series of material-gathering quests.
Once an animal has recovered, it becomes available for adoption directly from the clinic counter. Each rescued animal can only be adopted once.
The mod is available in both English and Simplified Chinese.
[b]Installation Instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Download and unzip AMPlify Valley.[/*]
[*]Place the complete
[code]AMPlify Valley[/code]folder inside your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Keep both
[code][CP] AMPlifyValley[/code]and
[code][SMAPI] AMPlifyValley[/code]inside the main folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]The finished structure should look like this:
[code]Stardew Valley/
└── Mods/
    └── AMPlify Valley/
        ├── [CP] AMPlifyValley/
        └── [SMAPI] AMPlifyValley/[/code]When updating the mod, replace the previous AMPlify Valley folder with the new version. Do not install multiple copies at the same time.
[b]Main Features[/b]
[list]
[*]A new pet clinic in Pelican Town.[/*]
[*]Mia, the clinic owner and rescued-animal caretaker.[/*]
[*]An introductory letter delivered early in the game.[/*]
[*]A continuing series of recovery quests delivered through dialogue and mail.[/*]
[*]Current recovery cases include a fox, border collie, hedgehog, lovebird, and Samoyed.[/*]
[*]Material-gathering objectives designed around animal care and recovery.[/*]
[*]Recovery periods between quests instead of every case appearing immediately.[/*]
[*]A dedicated clinic counter for adopting recovered animals.[/*]
[*]Each recovered animal can only be adopted once.[/*]
[*]No adoption fee.[/*]
[*]Full English and Simplified Chinese text.[/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.10 or later[/*]
[*]Content Patcher 2.9.1 or later[/*]
[/list]Both parts included in the download are required. The Content Patcher component provides the clinic, NPC, quests, mail, dialogue, maps, and animal data. The SMAPI component controls the clinic adoption system and one-time adoption tracking.
[b]Shout Outs[/b]
Created by AMPlify, the first iGEM team from Northwest A&F University.
Special thanks to every AMPlify team member, artist, writer, and tester who helped bring the clinic and its rescued animals to life.
Thanks to ConcernedApe for creating Stardew Valley, Pathoschild for SMAPI and Content Patcher, and the Stardew Valley modding community for its documentation, tools, and support.
